authors.bio: David Strachan is Director of marketing for Leitch Technology, based in Toronto, Canada. Born in the U.K., Strachan obtained Grad. IERE membership in London in 1968. Since that time he has worked in the television broadcasting industry, first with EMI and Rank in the U.K. and for several transmitter and satellite equipment suppliers in Canada, prior to joining Leitch as international sales manager in 1985.
